Visitor replaces subscript with custom template

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
visitor = Class.new do
  def visit_subscript(ctx, text)
    { custom: "~#{text}~" }
  end
end.new
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>H<sub>2</sub>O is water.</p>', visitor)
puts result.inspect
```
